assets.title: Continuous Drip-Fringe Icicle Cluster
assets.description: One original low-poly hanging icicle fringe, seven unequal drips and their continuous irregular thick frozen lip form one closed editable mesh and count as one prop. Each drip has seven descending octagonal sections with continuous nonlinear narrowing, a mild drifting axis, a broad joined root and a finite blunt end. A planar bounded back attachment patch lies on source Y=0.075 m, X=-0.56 to 0.56 m, Z=1.015 to 1.065 m, facing +Y. The origin is the source design datum at (0,0,0), below the central lip, not a ground contact; all parts belong to one monolithic boundary. This is a hanging attachment with no independent standing or stability claim. Four opaque constant PBR ice colours, metres, source Z up, front -Y. No textures, transmission, refractive or fluid simulation, roof, support, scene, animation or variants. A temporary rectangular QA support touching the back patch is a geometric witness only and is excluded from the native model, GLB and formal images. No ice-growth, melting, dripping, scientific ice morphology, temperature, ice mass, hanging load, strength, falling-ice safety, manufacture, installation or physical suitability claim. No universal attachment, existing roof, snowbank, cliff, waterfall or other earlier asset compatibility is asserted.
